title: Bob Dole Congressional Gold Medal Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Bob Dole Congressional Gold Medal Act

(Sec. 3) This bill directs the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for the award of a Congressional Gold Medal to Bob Dole in recognition for his service to the nation as a soldier, legislator, and statesman.

summary.headline: Congress directed its leaders to arrange a Congressional Gold Medal award to former Senator Bob Dole for his military and public service.
summary.what_it_does: This law tells the Speaker of the House and the President pro tempore of the Senate to arrange for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to Bob Dole. The stated purpose is to recognize his service to the nation as a soldier, legislator, and statesman. It is a commemorative honor and does not create new rules, benefits, or obligations for the public.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on September 15, 2017.
